item.title: Laurel County community gathers to stand up to bullying, one truck at a time
item.description: After a video of a bullying incident at North Laurel High School surfaced late last week, community members decided to take a stand against bullying.

item.title: Sister of woman killed in Lincoln County fire demands answers more than a year later
item.description: More than a year after a camper fire killed a 37-year-old mother in Lincoln County, her sister says she still does not have the answers she deserves — and has taken it upon herself to find them.

item.title: Iranian exile living in KY says US military strikes bring hope for long-awaited regime change
item.description: Mehrooz Mehrizi left Iran in 1990, shortly after Ali Khamenei took over as Supreme Leader. Now living in Kentucky, he says the ongoing U.S. conflict with Iran is giving him hope
